nom: Paula's Choice Calm Barrier Protect Mineral Sunscreen SPF 30

avis.titre: It’s the Goldilocks Zone of Physical Sunscreen- not too shiny, not too drying
avis.texte: This sunscreen 1) Doesn’t make my skin shiny like I dipped my face in margarine- I know some folks love the “glow” look - but that’s not for me - this looks like skin 2) Doesn’t make my skin look dry, flaky and dull or accentuate my dry patches by making them look extra white and noticeable 3) Doesn’t aggravate my skin or break me out 4) Doesn’t smell 5) Doesn’t make my concealer pill or look like paste 6) Doesn’t make me look like a ghost 7) Doesn’t take forever to rub in It’s a bit pricey, but for a physical sunscreen, it’s in the Goldilocks zone for my pale, dry, sensitive winter skin. I apply over basic moisturizer like Cetaphil. For comparison: Vanicream is less pricey but takes wayyyy longer to rub in and is shinier. Elta MD Clear is more expensive, absorbs super fast with no initial white cast, but leaves me dry with white flakes by day’s end. It

avis.titre: Gave me a rash/flared my rosacea :(Gave me a rash/flared my rosacea :(
avis.texte: I didn't want to give it just one star because I'm sure this spf will work for a lot of people. The formula doesn't feel super heavy and the whitecast isn't horrible. It has calming ingredients and washes off easily. However it did give me an itchy rash after two uses and flared my rosacea. So unfortunately it just isn't for me. I will say I have spent hundreds of dollars on sunscreen and all of them do the same, so my skin is HIGHLY intolerant and I probably have ingredient allergies that I'm unaware of. Just sad I spend $40 only to end up with a rash. :(

Have already repurchased for a second time!!! Love the finish and feel of this product. As a brown person, I struggle with finding a mineral sunscreen that doesn't make me look like a ghost. This one works perfect for my needs, I just wish it had more SPF. Will continue to use!

Do not buy if you have a octocrylene sensitivity. This is NOT a mineral sunscreen. This contains ethylhexyl methoxycrylene as the 4th ingredient. This chemical is an O-methyl substituted version of octocrylene, which I learned after having a reaction to this product.

I am currently on a medication that makes my face extremely dry and this helped not just keep hydration to the face, but also calm redness. So many of my products were triggering perioral dermatitis on my face and this is one of the few SPFs that help helps with that and with acne. I can rarely ever find this SPF in store anywhere so this is my go to to purchase it when I need it.

avis.titre: Rubs in easily and great for everyday use
avis.texte: Best mineral sunscreen that I wear every day! I rarely reapply and even with fair skin, I'm keeping sun off my face. I'm afraid they are discontinuing it because they don't have it on the Paula's choice website... I'll keep buying it here until it's gone but I don't know what other brand makes a mineral sunscreen that is this effective and doesn't make your skin white.

Make favorite mineral sunscreen ever! Easy to apply, very light cast but it goes away. This is one of those that you can reaply every two hours and it feels doable. The others feel chunky and I don't even want tot try re-applying.

I like the combination of moisturizer and sunscreen and the fact that it is unscented. It comes in a small 2 oz tube that is 6 inches long, including the cap. Despite the price, I like it. I have fair skin that burns quickly. I apply this sunscreen 15 minutes before going outside and reapply every two hours. Note that this is not a water-resistant sunscreen. The instructions say that if you plan to sweat or swim, you need to use another product. Active Ingredients: Titanium Dioxide 5.25%, Zinc Oxide 3.60% Ali Julia review Review of Paula’s Choice CALM Barrier Protect Mineral Moisturizer Sunscreen SPF 30

This Paula's Choice moisturizer aims to accomplish much more than just moisturizing your skin. It's a sunscreen - 30 SPF, though I wish it was 50 SPF. It has centella in it, which forms a barrier to protect your skin from losing moisture. It has Allantoin in it, which calms irritation and redness. It's fragrance free, which helps to ensure that it will not irritate. All this, plus it moisturizes as well. I have used this product several times now with mixed results. The first couple times I think I used too much because it felt heavy on my skin, too heavy to apply foundation over. So I would say, start slow, a little of this goes a long way. When first applying it, the cream was white on my skin, but after 15 minutes or so it was fully absorbed. Used minimally this moisturizer / barrier cream / sunscreen makes a nice prep for a foundation. If I was going into the sun for a long time I would put on more of this cream and skip the foundation. If it were hot enough to make my face sweat, reapplying would be necessary as it is not waterproof. It will take more time to see if there are any differences in my pink Celtic complexion, but so far I like this product very much. $37 (at time of this review) seems a little pricey but it is a careful formulation from an established brand so I believe the cost is justified.

avis.titre: Comfortable and easy for me to blend in, but needs more SPF
avis.texte: I have a hard time with sunscreen on my face, wether it’s breakouts or sensitivity, I have to use serums that are just meant for the face. I’ve had a few that leave a white cast or cause breakouts…this one did neither of those things and it was very easy to blend into my skin. I also found it comfortable to wear in the southern heat. I’ve had varying success with Paula’s products, because my skin is sensitive, but in this case I would use it again. At this time, however, it’s almost $19 per ounce so it’s not a good value for a 30 SPF lotion. I have daily lotions with 30 SPF, so to call this a sunscreen is surprising to me. If this is more than a serum with SPF, it should be at least 45 for more substantial protection.

The texture of this sunscreen is thin, applies easily, is lightweight. The sunscreen provided decent sun coverage with no irritation to my skin, very little scent. The sunscreen was very moisturizing, leaving a beautiful glow. This is a great mineral sunscreen choice and I would consider repurchasing.
